_readme: Which Orange Pis each robot has, and which cameras each Pi runs. Bootstrap-OrangePi.ps1 reads this,
so  .\Bootstrap-OrangePi.ps1 LeftPi  (or  -All  for every Pi) needs no typing. Command-line options
robot     : -Robot <name>, default 'defaultRobot'. Add a block per robot; boards may share names across robots.
name      : the board's NetworkTables name (metrics at /OrangePi/<name>/). Unique on one robot.
hosts     : network addresses of the Pi, tried in order (normally just <hostname>.local; an IP also works).
cameras   : name = the recorder instance (recordings folder); stream = PhotonVision's RAW MJPEG
stream as the Pi sees it (input stream of PhotonVision camera i is port 1181 + 2*i).
Filled in from the 11-07 bootstrap of both Pis (notes/11-7/bootStrappingLogs.md).

2027.description: 2027 offseason robot: two Orange Pi 5s, one Arducam OV9281 each
